sources.title: gemma-3-12b-qat-abliterated-sikaworld-fp4-ltx2
sources.snippet: This repository provides two custom FP4 variants of the uncensored Gemma‑3‑12B‑QAT model created by mlabonne using his improved Abliteration v2 method. Both models are fully uncensored, explicitly optimized for LTX‑2 and of course LTX-2.3, and designed to deliver strong motion vectors while maintaining spatial coherence.

sources.title: Gemma 3 12B abliterated weights arrive in fp8 quantization
sources.snippet: An fp8-quantized abliterated variant of Gemma 3 12B Instruct surfaced this week, stripping safety layers for uncensored text generation.
